text:
alex: Quick handoff / sync for asia-east ingress+residency — we need owners on BGP announces, KMS key mapping, DB read-rep placement, and canary plan. Cutover target: Tue 09:00 UTC. @riley @meera @dan please confirm ownership and blockers.

riley: I can take BGP announces. I'll post the announce snippet + peering ticket. question: do we use dedicated peer or shared transit?

meera: KMS/key mapping on my side but need final IAM from platform. tagging @luis for KMS principal approval.

luis: I own KMS principal approval. Will review IAM change today. We need the key alias to match region label (alias/redwood/asia-east).

riley: BGP announce plan (prelim):
```
# example (not the live config)
neighbor 203.0.113.1 remote-as 64512
neighbor 203.0.113.1 route-map IMPORT in
set community 65000:310  # 310 -> asia-east-sgp
```
I'll open peering ticket with that community. Need confirmation on the community number from neteng.

dan: DB read-rep: infra will provision a read replica in sgp zone, but subnet ACLs currently block egress to our primary replica. I filed infra ticket INF-482. Blocker until ACLs are adjusted.

alex: Noted. Dan, can you link INF-482 and ETA? we shouldn't merge schema migrations until replica is up.

dan: INF-482: https://internal/INF-482 ETA EOD Mon if neteng approves ACL change.

meera: Canary plan proposal: route 5% traffic to asia-east for 2 hours, run perf + correctness checks, then 25% for 1 hour, then 100% green. Add automatic rollback on error rate > 1.5%.

riley: SGTM. For routing we'll use weighted policy on the edge LB to control percent. I'll add rollout steps in the runbook.

alex: Anyone running model-serving capacity checks for asia-east GPUs? we need to confirm Dedicated pool quotas. @oncall-bot did we run quota check sweep?

oncall-bot: Quota check report: asia-east GPU quota available: 40 units, reserved for Dedicated: 10 units. (report id Q-202903).

luis: KMS note: if we create a customer-managed key in asia-east, we must enable cross-region key usage for backup decrypts in primary region. I'll add that to the PR.

meera: IAM PR: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/412 - needs @luis approval and @dan for subnet role updates.

riley: Peering ticket opened NET-1398, asked for maintenance window Tue 07:00-08:00 UTC. Neteng requested AS prep and LOA from cloud provider.

alex: Action items summary: 1) Riley: BGP announce + peering LOA (NET-1398). 2) Dan: unblock INF-482 ACL change. 3) Luis: approve KMS PR & add cross-region key use. 4) Meera: finalize IAM PR & canary metrics. 5) Infra: confirm GPU quotas. Can we check back EOD? :thumbsup:

riley: I'll post the final announce snippet + runbook update here when done.

dan: I'll push ACL change PR as soon as neteng signs off.

luis: I'll review IAM PR today.

meera: I'll add canary dashboards and smoke prompts to runbook (links included).

alex: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll move cutover.

riley: (posted runbook link) https://runbooks.internal/asia-east-handoff

meera: one last note — compliance needs a data residency confirmation doc for legal before 100% traffic shift. I'll coordinate with compliance on Monday.

alex: ok filing that as extra step, thanks.
